name: t9e2e-api

dependencies.name: t9e2e-db
dependencies.description: Stores tasks (title, completed state, creator, timestamps).

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates the caller's token and resolves their role for authorization.

description: Go API backed by Postgres for the shared task board. Lets any signed-in user list tasks, and lets Admins create tasks and mark them complete. Validates the caller's Thunder token on every request and enforces the Viewer/Admin role split. Does not serve the web app's UI.
